expanded.$description: SideNav's full width — also its width while a SideNavLevel is open (the level panel shares it with the rail). Consumers offset page content by this (margin-inline-start) because SideNav is position: fixed. Blade uses 240px, or 264px from its xl breakpoint; this project's breakpoint tokens have no xl, so there is one value.

collapsed.$description: SideNav's icon-only rail: its whole width when isExpanded is false, and L1's width (on top of the level panel) while a SideNavLevel is open.
